skills.name: Basic Attack: Smash 'n' Bash
skills.desc:
Press  to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 slashes, dealing Physical DMG.
When Koleda has the Furnace Fire effect, she can launch an enhanced Basic Attack after the 2nd hit, consuming the Furnace Fire effect and dealing massive Fire DMG.
Koleda and Ben can team up when fighting together to launch a coordinated attack, further increasing the power of the attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
‍["e2dmg": data shows 404.9 as starting amount, whereas in-game it's 404.8]

skills.name: Dodge: Wait 'n' See
skills.desc:
Press  to activate:
A rapid dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Dash Attack: Tremble!
skills.desc:
Press  during a dodge to activate:
Slashes all nearby enemies, dealing Physical damage.

skills.name: Dodge Counter: Don't Look Down on Me
skills.desc:
Press  during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Strikes enemies in front and creates an explosion, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Quick Assist: Coming Thru!
skills.desc:
Assist
Quick Assist
When the on-field character is launched, press  to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Defensive Assist: Protective Hammer
skills.desc:
Assist
Defensive Assist
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press  to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Assist Follow-Up: Hammer Bell
skills.desc:
Assist
Assist Follow-Up
Press  after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Koleda charges and strikes enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG and obtaining Furnace Fire effect.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Special Attack: Hammer Time
skills.desc:
Press  to activate:
Strikes enemies in front and triggers an explosion, dealing Fire DMG.
This skill launches faster and triggers an explosion when used after the 2nd or 4th hit of Koleda's Basic Attack or enhanced Basic Attack.
When Koleda and Ben are both in your squad, and this skill is activated after an enhanced Basic Attack, they team up to launch a coordinated attack, further increasing the power of the skill.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: EX Special Attack: Boiling Furnace
skills.desc:
With enough Energy, press  to activate:
Strikes enemies in front and triggers a powerful explosion, dealing massive Fire DMG. Koleda also gains the Furnace Fire effect.
This skill activates faster and triggers an explosion when used after the 2nd or 4th hit of Koleda's Basic Attack or enhanced Basic Attack.
When Koleda and Ben are both in your squad and this skill is activated after an enhanced Basic Attack, they team up to launch a coordinated attack, further increasing the power of the skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Chain Attack: Natural Disaster
skills.desc:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful explosion on enemies in a large area, dealing massive Fire DMG while also obtaining the Furnace Fire effect.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Ultimate: Hammerquake
skills.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press  to activate:
Unleashes a powerful explosion on enemies in a large area in front, dealing massive Fire DMG while also obtaining the Furnace Fire effect.
Koleda and Ben can team up when fighting together to launch a coordinated attack, further increasing the power of the attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Core Passive: Demolition Hammer
skills.desc: When Koleda uses her Ex Special Attack or consumes Furnace Fire to use an enhanced Basic Attack, the Daze she deals increases by X%.

skills.name: Additional Ability: Belobog Management
skills.desc:
When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction or is a Rupture character:
When the explosion from Koleda's EX Special Attack hits an enemy, it applies a debuff to the target. While the target is Stunned, Chain Attacks deal 35% more DMG to the target. This effect can stack up to 2 times and resets when the Stunned effect ends.

cons.name: Beat of the Hammer
cons.desc: After the 2nd or 4th hit of Koleda's Basic Attack or her enhanced Basic Attack, quickly use a Special Attack or EX Special Attack to increase the Daze dealt by 15%.

cons.name: Kinetic Recovery
cons.desc: When Koleda's EX Special Attack hits an enemy, she recovers 60 Energy. Can trigger once every 45s.

cons.name: "Mind Your Own!"
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cons.name: Furnace's Glow
cons.desc:
Koleda gains one stack of Charge (max 2 stacks) when consuming Furnace Fire to use her Enhanced Basic Attack.
When her Chain Attack: Natural Disaster or Ultimate: Hammerquake hits an enemy, she consumes all stacks of Charge to increase the attack's DMG by 18% per stack.

cons.name: "You Dare Underestimate Me?"
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cons.name: Saturated Blast
cons.desc: When EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate triggers an explosion that hits an enemy, it deals additional DMG equal to 360% of Koleda's ATK.
